original_test_intent: Change the named BIOS attribute through Redfish, activate it by reboot, verify the active value, and restore the approved final state without unrelated BIOS drift.
original_method: Verify target and attribute registry; save current active/pending settings and ETag; obtain approved meaning of value 2 and restore value; PATCH only the named attribute with valid JSON and concurrency control; follow task/apply semantics; reboot once; verify active value and platform health; restore and re-verify final state.
manual_activity: Operator approves target/test/restore values, backup and recovery and supervises reboot; agent may issue one validated PATCH and collect evidence.
required_inputs: BMC/BIOS/SUT build and Redfish BIOS registry
Meaning and support of CbsCmnApbdisDfPstate value 2 plus original/final value
ETag, pending-settings, apply-time and reboot semantics
Backup, console/BIOS recovery, maintenance approval and boot-health oracle
safety_requirements: Use valid JSON, TLS, protected credentials and current ETag policy
Back up active/pending BIOS settings and preserve independent console recovery
Patch only the named attribute once; stop on task/PATCH/boot error or unrelated drift
Restore and verify the approved final value; never retry automatically
agent_execution_scope: Submit one approved attribute-only PATCH and monitor task/apply status
Collect reboot, active-value, boot-health, drift and restore evidence
Do not invent value semantics, omit recovery, alter unrelated settings, retry or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve value mapping, initial/test/final matrix and schema
Approve backup, recovery and health criteria
Review evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source payload contains doubled JSON quotes, supplies an empty If-Match header, gives no meaning for value 2 or expected value, and calls only for readable/correct data. Executing it literally is invalid or unsafe and cannot establish the title's setting contract.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The attribute transition is identifiable and can be run once the registry, value matrix and recovery plan are supplied; static review is complete.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2256 Wistron-BMC Sanity-00038-V001: approve BMC/BIOS build, Redfish BIOS registry and exact meaning/support of `CbsCmnApbdisDfPstate=2`; define initial/test/final values, active versus pending resource, ETag/If-Match and apply/reboot semantics; approve configuration backup, one-shot PATCH/reboot, boot-health oracle, unrelated-setting diff, restore workflow and console/BIOS recovery while preserving the malformed Master text as source evidence.

review_improvement: Converts an unsafe ambiguous persistent mutation into a bounded reversible BIOS-settings transaction without reducing the original attribute/reboot coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: Redfish BIOS Settings normally stages values until reset and may enforce ETags and registry enumerations. The source's doubled quotes are not a valid one-layer JSON body and an empty If-Match provides no concurrency guarantee. A grep around the key can also confuse current and pending state. Therefore authoritative registry semantics, active/pending comparison, reboot health and restoration are required before any execution or verdict.
